messages:
eva: Heads-up — Pegasus wants to run a joint perf/W and throughput sweep next week. I sketched a minimal matrix: 3 models (7b/13b/70b), sequence lengths 512/2048, batch sizes 1/4/8, and three kernel configs (default, memory-optimized, quantized-float8). Need to confirm telemetry, power hooks, and data sharing agreement.

morgan: +1. Can you drop the matrix here? Also need to know which power sensors Pegasus will expose (IPMI, external meter, onboard sensors).

eva: matrix pasted below (short):
```
models: llama-7b, owl-13b, soar-70b
seq_lens: 512, 2048
batches: 1, 4, 8
kernel_profiles: default, mem_opt, q8_no_bias
metrics: latency_p50/p95, throughput_tps, tokens_per_joule, tail_cpu/gpu_temp
```
We should collect per-request KV cache hits, batching stats, and model-variant fallback counts.

alex (Pegasus): We can expose wall-meter (Fluke) and IPMI telemetry. On the board we can stream onboard power at 10Hz. We prefer receiving logs via an S3 bucket with pre-signed put URLs; redwood will push run configs to that bucket. Is that OK?

morgan: S3 approach fine. We'll encrypt upload with customer keys. Two asks: 1) a CSV schema for the power samples (timestamp, watts, sensor_id), 2) a sample of the board's kernel cmdline and the kernel module versions so our perf team can map regressions.

alex (Pegasus): Sending CSV schema and current cmdline in DM. Also note: the mem_opt kernel uses a patched GEM allocator — we need to run a short stability smoke before full sweep.

eva: Good catch. Plan: run smoke on one config (owl-13b, seq512, batch4, mem_opt) to validate stability and telemetry. If smoke passes, schedule full run in two windows (night runs) to avoid customer noise.

sam: For bench infra, I'll provide a runner script and a docker image. Quick example command (will be in repo):
```
./run_bench --model owl-13b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --profile mem_opt --power-log s3://pegasus-handshake/run123/power.csv --out s3://pegasus-handshake/run123/metrics.json
```
It will emit a metrics.json with: p50, p95, throughput, tokens_per_joule, gpu_temp_max, kernel_version, profile_tag.

eva: Thanks. We also need an NDA addendum for telemetry export and a short public statement template in case we co-announce numbers. Legal asked for wording: no raw power traces publicly, aggregated perf/W only.

alex (Pegasus): That's acceptable. We prefer aggregated per-config mean +/- std dev and plots. We'll add a note that both parties validate runs.

morgan: Action items:
- alex: upload CSV schema + cmdline + stability checklist (due in 24h)
- sam: publish runner image + example commands + repo README (due EOD two days)
- eva: draft telemetry NDA addendum + public blurb (due tomorrow)
- bench-bot: schedule smoke run window slot and notify infra-oncall

bench-bot: scheduled smoke run for 2025-06-18T02:00Z in slot #B-4 (auto-alert to #eng-runtime and #eng-sre).

eva: I'll loop in legal and release comms after we get the schema. If smoke fails, we'll triage kernel patch and retry. If it passes, we aim to complete full sweep within 72 hours with nightly chunks. :thumbsup:

alex (Pegasus): Sounds good — I'll DM the files and ping when uploads are ready. Excited to get this done.

morgan: Great — please post any anomalies as short notes in this thread so partners have a single source of truth.

eva: Closing the loop here. Will update thread when NDA draft is ready. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
